appointments_visit_link_check.name: appointments_visit_link_check
appointments_visit_link_check.value: (status in ('checked_in', 'completed') and visit_id is not null) or (status in ('booked', 'rescheduled') and visit_id is null) or status in ('cancelled', 'no_show')

appointments_not_self_check.name: appointments_not_self_check
appointments_not_self_check.value: rescheduled_from is distinct from id and rescheduled_to is distinct from id

encounters_signed_complete.name: encounters_signed_complete
encounters_signed_complete.value: status <> 'signed' or (signed_at is not null and signed_snapshot is not null and content_hash is not null)

encounters_discarded_complete.name: encounters_discarded_complete
encounters_discarded_complete.value: status <> 'discarded' or (discarded_at is not null and discarded_by is not null and length(btrim(coalesce(discard_reason, ''))) > 0)

investigation_results_text_check.name: investigation_results_text_check
investigation_results_text_check.value: length(btrim(test_name)) between 1 and 120 and length(btrim(value_text)) between 1 and 60 and length(coalesce(unit, '')) <= 20 and length(coalesce(ref_text, '')) <= 60 and length(coalesce(note, '')) <= 300 and length(coalesce(status_reason, '')) <= 200

investigation_results_range_check.name: investigation_results_range_check
investigation_results_range_check.value: ref_low is null or ref_high is null or ref_low <= ref_high

investigation_results_dates_check.name: investigation_results_dates_check
investigation_results_dates_check.value: resulted_on is null or resulted_on >= collected_on

mana_messages_text_check.name: mana_messages_text_check
mana_messages_text_check.value: "mana_messages"."text" is null or length(btrim("mana_messages"."text")) between 1 and 500

patient_conditions_since_check.name: patient_conditions_since_check
patient_conditions_since_check.value: since_year between 1900 and 2200 and (since_month is null or since_month between 1 and 12)

patient_conditions_text_check.name: patient_conditions_text_check
patient_conditions_text_check.value: length(btrim(name)) between 1 and 120 and length(coalesce(note, '')) <= 300 and length(coalesce(status_reason, '')) <= 200

patient_medications_text_check.name: patient_medications_text_check
patient_medications_text_check.value: length(btrim(drug_name)) between 1 and 120 and length(btrim(dose)) between 1 and 60 and length(btrim(frequency)) between 1 and 60 and length(coalesce(reason, '')) <= 200 and length(coalesce(status_reason, '')) <= 200

patient_medications_dates_check.name: patient_medications_dates_check
patient_medications_dates_check.value: stopped_on is null or started_on is null or stopped_on >= started_on

patient_medications_stopped_on_check.name: patient_medications_stopped_on_check
patient_medications_stopped_on_check.value: stopped_on is null or status in ('stopped', 'entered_in_error')

thermal_labels_scope_check.name: thermal_labels_scope_check
thermal_labels_scope_check.value: ("thermal_labels"."scope" = 'capture' and "thermal_labels"."roi_label" is null) or ("thermal_labels"."scope" = 'roi' and "thermal_labels"."roi_label" is not null)

thermal_summaries_decision_check.name: thermal_summaries_decision_check
thermal_summaries_decision_check.value: ("thermal_summaries"."status" = 'pending') = ("thermal_summaries"."decided_at" is null) and (("thermal_summaries"."status" = 'edited') = ("thermal_summaries"."final_text" is not null))
